wiki.title: Tom Tiffany
wiki.extract: Thomas Patrick Tiffany (born December 30, 1957) is an American politician and businessman from Wisconsin. A member of the United States House of Representatives, he has represented Wisconsin's 7th congressional district since 2020. A member of the Republican Party, he is a member of the House Freedom Caucus.
